verdict.rationale: Floot documents backend server-side capabilities (endpoints, scheduled jobs, managed Postgres) and built-in integrations for transactional email and OAuth sign-in, plus a general workflow where describing an integration to the assistant builds the endpoints, tables, and screens (with a secure key-entry flow for API credentials). Payments specifically isn't named as a built-in integration, though the generic integration-building workflow implies it's supported. missing for 10: explicit documentation/example of a payments integration (e.g., Stripe) being added via the builder, and independent/hands-on confirmation beyond first-party docs.
